info.description: SentimentBase is sentiment analysis that answers on its free tier and shows its work. Every analysis returns the compound score, the label thresholds it used, a per-sentence breakdown (so a mixed review reads as mixed instead of averaging into a lie), and the exact words from your text that drove the score with their lexicon valences. The engine is VADER, an MIT-licensed lexicon built for social text; the lexicon version is reported in every response so scores stay comparable across calls. There is no code path that invents a quota error, which is the incumbent's most-documented failure; real failures are named structured errors.
